## Catch trends
Manta and Devil rays (mobulids) are captured as bycatch by the EPO tuna purse seine fishery. Catch rates have declined on average over time, possibly due to changes in fishing practices, reporting requirements, and/or declining populations. 
```{r}
#| echo: false

library(jsonlite)

mobulid_data <- read.csv("../Data/mob_set_summary.csv")
set_data <- read.csv("../Data/sum_set_year.csv")

chart_json <- toJSON(
  list(
    mobulids = mobulid_data,
    sets = set_data
  ),
  dataframe = "rows",
  auto_unbox = TRUE,
  na = "null"
)

```

```{=html}
<section id="mobulid-scroll-story">
  <div id="mobulid-scroll-chart">
    <svg id="mobulid-svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500"></svg>
  </div>
</section>
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

cat(
  '<script>
  const chartData = ',
  chart_json,
  ';
  </script>'
)
```


<script>

// ============================================================
// 1. DATA AND SVG SETUP
// ============================================================

// Access datasets prepared in R
const mobulidData = chartData.mobulids;
const setData = chartData.sets;

// CHANGE THIS to match your mobulid count column
const mobulidCountColumn = "mob_sets";

const svg = d3.select("#mobulid-svg");
const story = document.getElementById("mobulid-scroll-story");
const container = d3.select("#mobulid-scroll-chart");

// Chart dimensions
const width = 800;
const height = 500;

const margin = {
  top: 40,
  right: 95,
  bottom: 100,
  left: 80
};

const bottom = height - margin.bottom;
const right = width - margin.right;
const plotHeight = bottom - margin.top;

// Line and axis colors
const mobColor = "#2F6F7E";
const setColor = "#C17A32";

// Set-type line styles
const setTypes = ["NOA", "OBJ", "DEL"];

const setStyles = {
  NOA: null,       // Solid
  OBJ: "9 5",      // Dashed
  DEL: "2 5"       // Dotted
};

// Sort both datasets chronologically
mobulidData.sort((a, b) => +a.Year - +b.Year);
setData.sort((a, b) => +a.Year - +b.Year);


// ============================================================
// 2. SCALES
// ============================================================

// Shared x-axis
const allYears = [
  ...mobulidData.map(d => +d.Year),
  ...setData.map(d => +d.Year)
];

const xScale = d3.scaleLinear()
  .domain(d3.extent(allYears))
  .range([margin.left, right]);

// Left y-axis: sets with mobulid captures
const mobMax = d3.max(
  mobulidData,
  d => +d[mobulidCountColumn]
) || 1;

const yScaleLeft = d3.scaleLinear()
  .domain([0, mobMax])
  .nice()
  .range([bottom, margin.top]);

// Right y-axis: total fishing sets
const setMax = d3.max(setData, d =>
  d3.max(setTypes, type => +d[type] || 0)
) || 1;

const yScaleRight = d3.scaleLinear()
  .domain([0, setMax])
  .nice()
  .range([bottom, margin.top]);

// Figure title
const chartTitle = svg.append("text")
  .attr("class", "chart-title")
  .attr("x", (margin.left + right) / 2)
  .attr("y", 20)
  .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
  .style("font-size", "20px")
  .style("font-weight", "bold")
  .style("fill", "#2F6F7E")
  .text("Mobulid bycatch events over time");

// ============================================================
// 3. AXES AND LABELS
// ============================================================

// Bottom x-axis
svg.append("g")
  .attr("transform", `translate(0,${bottom})`)
  .call(d3.axisBottom(xScale).tickFormat(d3.format("d")));

// Left y-axis
const leftAxis = svg.append("g")
  .attr("transform", `translate(${margin.left},0)`)
  .call(d3.axisLeft(yScaleLeft));

leftAxis.selectAll("path, line")
  .attr("stroke", mobColor);

leftAxis.selectAll("text")
  .attr("fill", mobColor);

// Right y-axis clipping mask
// Allows the axis to grow upward from the bottom
const axisReveal = svg.append("defs")
  .append("clipPath")
  .attr("id", "axis-reveal-clip")
  .attr("clipPathUnits", "userSpaceOnUse")
  .append("rect")
  .attr("x", 0)
  .attr("y", bottom)
  .attr("width", 100)
  .attr("height", 0);

// Right y-axis
const rightAxis = svg.append("g")
  .attr("transform", `translate(${right},0)`)
  .attr("clip-path", "url(#axis-reveal-clip)")
  .call(d3.axisRight(yScaleRight));

rightAxis.selectAll("path, line")
  .attr("stroke", setColor);

rightAxis.selectAll("text")
  .attr("fill", setColor);

// X-axis label
svg.append("text")
  .attr("x", width / 2)
  .attr("y", height - 65)
  .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
  .text("Year");

// Left y-axis label
svg.append("text")
  .attr("transform", "rotate(-90)")
  .attr("x", -(height / 2))
  .attr("y", 22)
  .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
  .attr("fill", mobColor)
  .text("Sets with bycatch");

// Right y-axis label
const rightLabel = svg.append("text")
  .attr("transform", "rotate(90)")
  .attr("x", height / 2)
  .attr("y", -width + 15)
  .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
  .attr("fill", setColor)
  .attr("opacity", 0)
  .text("Total sets");


// ============================================================
// 4. MOBULID SET LINE
// ============================================================

const mobulidLine = d3.line()
  .x(d => xScale(+d.Year))
  .y(d => yScaleLeft(+d[mobulidCountColumn]));

const mobPath = svg.append("path")
  .datum(mobulidData)
  .attr("d", mobulidLine)
  .attr("fill", "none")
  .attr("stroke", mobColor)
  .attr("stroke-width", 3);

// Measure line length for scroll animation
const mobLength = mobPath.node().getTotalLength();

// Hide line until scrolling begins
mobPath
  .attr("stroke-dasharray", mobLength)
  .attr("stroke-dashoffset", mobLength);


// ============================================================
// 5. SET-TYPE LINES
// ============================================================

// Line generator using right y-axis
const setLine = d3.line()
  .x(d => xScale(+d.Year))
  .y(d => yScaleRight(+d.value));

// Store line paths and their clipping masks
const setPaths = setTypes.map((type, i) => {

  // Reshape data for D3
  const values = setData.map(d => ({
    Year: d.Year,
    value: +d[type] || 0
  }));

  // Create individual clipping mask
  const clipId = `set-clip-${i}`;

  const reveal = svg.append("defs")
    .append("clipPath")
    .attr("id", clipId)
    .attr("clipPathUnits", "userSpaceOnUse")
    .append("rect")
    .attr("x", margin.left)
    .attr("y", margin.top)
    .attr("width", 0)
    .attr("height", plotHeight);

  // Draw set-type line
  const path = svg.append("path")
    .datum(values)
    .attr("d", setLine)
    .attr("fill", "none")
    .attr("stroke", setColor)
    .attr("stroke-width", 2.5)
    .attr("stroke-dasharray", setStyles[type] || "none")
    .attr("stroke-linecap", "round")
    .attr("clip-path", `url(#${clipId})`);

  return { type, path, reveal, clipId };
});



// ============================================================
// 6. INTERACTIVE TOOLTIPS + HOVER HIGHLIGHT
// ============================================================

// Add your descriptions and image paths here
const setInfo = {
  NOA: {
    title: "NOA Sets",
    description: "Add your description of NOA sets here.",
    image: "images/noa_sets.jpg"
  },
  OBJ: {
    title: "OBJ Sets",
    description: "Add your description of OBJ sets here.",
    image: "images/obj_sets.jpg"
  },
  DEL: {
    title: "DEL Sets",
    description: "Add your description of DEL sets here.",
    image: "images/del_sets.jpg"
  }
};

// Create tooltip using fixed positioning
const tooltip = container.append("div")
  .attr("class", "set-tooltip")
  .style("position", "fixed")
  .style("opacity", 0)
  .style("pointer-events", "none");

// Add wider invisible paths to make hovering easier
setPaths.forEach(({ type, path, clipId }) => {

  const hitPath = svg.append("path")
    .datum(path.datum())
    .attr("d", setLine)
    .attr("fill", "none")
    .attr("stroke", "transparent")
    .attr("stroke-width", 16)
    .attr("pointer-events", "stroke")
    .attr("clip-path", `url(#${clipId})`);

  hitPath
    .on("pointerenter", () => {

      // Fade the other two set-type lines
      setPaths.forEach(({ type: otherType, path: otherPath }) => {

        otherPath
          .transition()
          .duration(200)
          .style("opacity", otherType === type ? 1 : 0.2);

      });

      // Show tooltip
      const info = setInfo[type];

      tooltip
        .html(`
          <h3>${info.title}</h3>
          <img src="${info.image}" alt="${info.title}">
          <p>${info.description}</p>
        `)
        .style("opacity", 1);

    })
    .on("pointermove", event => {

      tooltip
        .style("left", `${event.clientX + 12}px`)
        .style("top", `${event.clientY + 12}px`);

    })
    .on("pointerleave", () => {

      // Restore all three lines
      setPaths.forEach(({ path }) => {

        path
          .transition()
          .duration(200)
          .style("opacity", 1);

      });

      tooltip.style("opacity", 0);

    });

});

// ============================================================
// 7. FINAL FIGURE LEGEND
// ============================================================

// Legend appears only after all lines finish drawing
const legend = svg.append("g")
  .attr("transform", "translate(120,470)")
  .attr("opacity", 0);

// Mobulid legend entry
const mobLegend = legend.append("g")
  .attr("transform", "translate(0,0)");

mobLegend.append("line")
  .attr("x1", 0)
  .attr("x2", 30)
  .attr("y1", 0)
  .attr("y2", 0)
  .attr("stroke", mobColor)
  .attr("stroke-width", 3);

mobLegend.append("text")
  .attr("x", 38)
  .attr("y", 5)
  .text("Mobulid captures");

// Set-type legend entries
setTypes.forEach((type, i) => {

  const item = legend.append("g")
    .attr("transform", `translate(${220 + i * 125},0)`);

  item.append("line")
    .attr("x1", 0)
    .attr("x2", 30)
    .attr("y1", 0)
    .attr("y2", 0)
    .attr("stroke", setColor)
    .attr("stroke-width", 2.5)
    .attr("stroke-dasharray", setStyles[type] || "none");

  item.append("text")
    .attr("x", 38)
    .attr("y", 5)
    .text(type);

});


// ============================================================
// 8. TWO-STAGE SCROLL ANIMATION
// ============================================================

function updateChart() {

  const stickyHeight = container.node().getBoundingClientRect().height;
  const stickyTop = window.innerHeight * 0.1;

  // Find the start and end of the sticky scroll section
  const sectionTop = story.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY;

  const start = sectionTop - stickyTop;
  const end = sectionTop + story.offsetHeight - stickyHeight - stickyTop;

  // Overall scroll progress: 0 to 1
  let progress = (window.scrollY - start) / (end - start);

  progress = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, progress));


  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // STAGE 1: Mobulid line (first 50% of scrolling)
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  const mobProgress = Math.min(progress / 0.5, 1);

  mobPath.attr(
    "stroke-dashoffset",
    mobLength * (1 - mobProgress)
  );


  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // STAGE 2: Fishing effort (second 50% of scrolling)
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  const secondProgress = Math.max(
    0,
    Math.min(1, (progress - 0.5) / 0.5)
  );

  // First 15%: reveal right y-axis from bottom upward
  const axisProgress = Math.min(secondProgress / 0.15, 1);

  axisReveal
    .attr("y", bottom - plotHeight * axisProgress)
    .attr("height", plotHeight * axisProgress);

  rightLabel.attr("opacity", axisProgress);

// Change title as the second y-axis appears
chartTitle
  .text(
    axisProgress > 0
      ? "Changes in fishing methodologies used by the fleet"
      : "Manta and devil ray bycatch events in the Eastern Pacific Ocean"
  )
  .style("fill", axisProgress > 0 ? "#C17A32" : "#2F6F7E");

  // Remaining 85%: reveal NOA, OBJ, and DEL lines
  const setProgress = Math.max(
    0,
    Math.min(1, (secondProgress - 0.15) / 0.85)
  );

  setPaths.forEach(({ reveal }) => {
    reveal.attr(
      "width",
      (right - margin.left) * setProgress
    );
  });


  // Final 8%: reveal legend
  const legendProgress = Math.max(
    0,
    Math.min(1, (setProgress - 0.92) / 0.08)
  );

  legend.attr("opacity", legendProgress);

}


// Listen for scrolling and resizing
window.addEventListener("scroll", updateChart, { passive: true });
window.addEventListener("resize", updateChart);

// Set correct initial appearance
updateChart();


</script>
